subject.title: fix(telegram): Allow multi-agent ACP bindings within same account

question: Should same-account ACP binds in one Telegram topic preserve multiple independent agent bindings, or is a same-account last-writer ownership switch the intended behavior?
rationale: The PR description promises independent multi-agent bindings, but the patch and tests implement replacement semantics; maintainers need to choose the product model before a correct storage-preserving repair can land.

options.title: Require Independent Bindings
options.body: Rework the PR so current plugin-state storage can preserve same-account same-topic bindings by session key while still rejecting cross-account takeover.

options.title: Accept Same-Account Handoff
options.body: Treat the latest same-account bind as an intentional ownership switch and update the PR description, tests, and proof to say so clearly.

options.title: Pause For Binding Design
options.body: Hold the PR until the Telegram ACP binding model is specified across routing, unbind, lifecycle updates, and live proof.

recommendation.title: Require Independent Bindings
recommendation.body: Rework the PR so current plugin-state storage can preserve same-account same-topic bindings by session key while still rejecting cross-account takeover.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current Telegram plugin-state persistence and migration direction that any repair must preserve.
